repos.name: Open-Dev-Society/OpenStock
repos.description: OpenStock is an open-source alternative to expensive market platforms. Track real-time prices, set personalized alerts, and explore detailed company insights — built openly, for everyone, forever free.
repos.one_liner: An open-source financial market platform for real-time price tracking and company insights.
bullets: Built with TypeScript for a responsive, real-time web interface.
Provides infrastructure for market data visualization and personalized financial alerts.
Serves as a transparent, free alternative to proprietary terminal and market data platforms.
Enables developers to integrate financial data streams into custom trading dashboards.

repos.name: jarrodwatts/jev-trader
repos.description: One AI trade decision every Monad block. Jev on Kuru MON-USDC.
repos.one_liner: An autonomous trading agent executing AI-driven decisions on the Monad blockchain.
bullets: Utilizes the Jev decision-making framework for high-frequency AI trade execution.
Operates on the Kuru exchange, specifically targeting the MON-USDC trading pair.
Demonstrates agentic finance by mapping AI inference directly to on-chain transaction blocks.
Serves as a blueprint for block-by-block automated DeFi strategies.

repos.name: higgsfield-ai/higgsfield
repos.description: Fault-tolerant, highly scalable GPU orchestration, and a machine learning framework designed for training models with billions to trillions of parameters
repos.one_liner: A scalable GPU orchestration and machine learning framework for training massive-scale models.
bullets: Designed for fault-tolerant distributed training of models with trillions of parameters.
Provides infrastructure for managing complex GPU clusters and high-performance computing workloads.
Optimized for large-scale AI research and production-grade model development.
Addresses the infrastructure bottleneck in training state-of-the-art foundation models.

repos.name: dexmal/opendm
repos.description: An Open-World Foundation Model for General-Purpose Embodied Intelligence.
repos.one_liner: An open-world foundation model designed for general-purpose embodied intelligence.
bullets: Leverages vision-language-action (VLA) architectures to bridge AI perception with physical execution.
Provides a foundational model framework for autonomous agents interacting with real-world environments.
Focuses on general-purpose task completion rather than narrow, domain-specific automation.
Acts as a core component for building next-generation agentic robotics and automation systems.

repos.name: feder-cr/invisible_playwright
repos.description: Free antidetect browser stealth for Playwright: undetected headless Firefox fingerprint. Python scraping, recaptcha and bot detection bypass. Open source
repos.one_liner: A stealth-focused browser automation tool for bypassing advanced bot detection and anti-scraping measures.
bullets: Implements undetected headless Firefox fingerprinting to mimic human browsing behavior.
Provides critical infrastructure for data collection, scraping, and automated research workflows.
Includes built-in bypass mechanisms for reCAPTCHA and sophisticated enterprise bot detection.
Essential for developers building reliable data-gathering agents that require high uptime.
